description: October 28–31, under the convention's “STEM for the Bold” banner. The delegation suited up for the convention floor, lined up behind the giant FAMILIA letters, and closed a night in Indianapolis over deep-dish pizza.
BU SHPE members joined the national familia in Philadelphia for the convention's career fair, workshops and networking.
BU SHPE members traveled to Anaheim for the convention's career fair, workshops and networking.
Members received interviews and offers, attended professional-growth workshops, and deepened bonds within the BU-SHPE familia.
Two-day career fair, technical workshops, and onsite interviews with the country's largest gathering of Hispanic STEM professionals.

November 10–14 at the Orange County Convention Center, the first in-person nationals after SHPE's fully virtual 2020 convention. A masked delegation lined up behind the FAMILIA letters and worked the career fair floor.
October 30 – November 3 at the Phoenix Convention Center. The delegation flew out together, lined up at the FAMILIA letters, and came home with a podium finish in the Cyber Security Challenge.
November 7–11 at the Huntington Convention Center, under the theme “Better Together.” The delegation posed in business attire behind the FAMILIA letters.
